verdict: Campaigns back live; 17 leads in 5 days at a strong early cost.
narrative: After a 20-day pause, paid advertising restarted on October 23rd and produced 17 leads over 5 active days at $13.08 per lead — an efficient early read against your historical baseline. Daily spend and lead volume have held steady through the first week, with no signs of fatigue yet. Your Google Business Profile activity also rose sharply, with 193 total actions across all three locations this period, though direction requests are outpacing calls at the lowest-performing location. Lead intake confirmation is currently unavailable due to a CRM connection issue being repaired, so the 17 leads are recorded on the ad platform but not yet CRM-verified; that fix is in progress now.
